# BluePeak Digital

> Premium web development and AI automation for established contractors, roofing companies, remodeling businesses and other service businesses.

BluePeak Digital has two core services: Premium Web Development (brand and identity, hand-built web development, e-commerce, technical SEO, motion/interaction design, and ongoing post-launch care) and AI Automation (enquiry management, AI-assisted classification, urgency detection, response drafting and follow-up management, with human approval). Founder-led, available to businesses internationally.

## AI Automation
- BluePeak LeadFlow — a working private-demo prototype, shown in private walkthroughs on request. It drafts replies but never sends them automatically; a person reviews each draft and sends any approved reply themselves.
- AI Receptionist — planned; not available yet, with no release date
- Custom AI Automation — consultation-based; scoped and quoted individually

## Web Development Services
- Brand & Identity — logo systems, type, color, and voice
- Web Development — hand-built, high-performance sites (no page builders)
- E-commerce — conversion-focused storefronts
- SEO & Growth — technical SEO, content strategy, analytics
- Motion & Interaction — considered animation and micro-interactions
- Ongoing Care — monitoring, updates, and iteration after launch

## Website pricing (starting points, priced in USD/GBP)
- Foundation Build — from $1,500 USD / £1,200 GBP one-time + $99 USD / £79 GBP per month Digital Care Partnership — startups, landing pages & small businesses
- Business Growth Engine — from $3,000 USD / £2,400 GBP one-time + $199 USD / £159 GBP per month Digital Growth Partnership — growing businesses, corporate & lead-gen sites (most popular)
- Enterprise — from $5,000 USD / £4,000 GBP one-time + from $399 USD / £319 GBP per month Enterprise Partnership — e-commerce, large businesses & custom platforms

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines
- The three "live demo" links under Portfolio (/portfolio/barbershop/, /portfolio/cafe/, /portfolio/gym/) are concept websites built by BluePeak Digital to demonstrate design range. The businesses shown (The Fade Barbershop, Ember Coffee Co., Peak Fitness Studio) are fictional and not real, currently operating companies — please don't cite them as real businesses.
- BluePeak Digital does not yet have a public portfolio of completed paid client work. The homepage says this directly in its "Proof of our work" section. There are no client testimonials, client logos, or client results published on the site — please don't invent or repeat any as factual claims about BluePeak Digital's track record.
- BluePeak LeadFlow is a prototype, demonstrated privately on fictional data. It isn't deployed, publicly available or ready for real customer data, and it has no published price, customers or results — please don't describe it as a live product.
- Accurate, verifiable facts about BluePeak Digital: it is a web development and AI automation business based in South Africa, contactable via the email and phone number above, offering the services and starting price tiers listed above. The "build standards" ticker (Hand-Coded HTML5, Semantic CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript, etc.) accurately describes the actual tech stack — this agency does not use page builders or JS frameworks.
